425486.overview:
For the 2020 Reset64 4k Craptastic Compo

An experiment has gone horribly wrong. While creating a dimensional bridge to another world, scientists accidentally capture four alien beings. The device goes haywire shortly thereafter and destroys the laboratory, forcing the scientists to flee. The four spherical aliens are trapped in our world, but a chance remains. The portal, at the heart of the lab, has not yet closed, and it will take the power of all of them to return home.

447948.overview: Welcome to Warzone - epic battle for dominance! In this Commodore 64 game two players take the helm of rival nations locked in a relentless war for supremacy.

452295.overview:
This is a fun little game I have made specifically at the last moment for the Reset Craptastic 2024 4K game compo. You are a worker at an explosives  factory. You have been sent outside to the water logged shipping yard, where you are operating a conveyor belt, with crates on board.
 
For every crate that passes points are scored. Yellow crates give 100 points and red crates award 200 points. Landing on yellow crates will stun you for a bit. 

LOSING LIVES:If you are pushed to the weak point of the red rollers, a fault occurs on the belt, resulting in you falling into the water. 

If you land on red crates or get hit by falling 10 ton weights will result in an instant death.

Everytime you lose a life you will restart the current level in which you are on. 

COMPLETING A LEVEL:To complete a level, the crate count in the status panel must equal to 000. Otherwise the game will continue playing - unless you lose a life or the game is over. There are 16 levels in total, which ranges in difficulty. The first level starts slow going, then as soon as you progress further the game will get even harder.

After level 4, a falling weight will appear on screen at random. Then on level 9, you'll see two. On level 13, the weights will fall faster.

453469.overview: Released At :Zoo 2024. You need to pack the wood nicely and don't let them crumble down! That kind of action goes against my grain and I may end up barking at you. Anyway, it is Tetris and there are more Tetrominoes to choose from, but all made from wooden sticks.

453796.overview: Guess the Wordle in 6 tries. After each guess, the colour of the titles will change to showhow close your guess was to the word.

454494.overview:
The New Dimension and Blazon proudly presents the crazy Commodore 64 game, Weights and Crates Deluxe. This is the complete full version of the 2024 Reset64 4kb 'Craptastic' Game Compo compo entry, Weights and Crates. Unlike the 4K version, this is the completely brand new enhanced version of the game. This version of the game consists of the following features:

Loading bitmap artwork with loading music
Front end presentation with in game sound options
Hi score table and saver (disk version)
5 pieces of music (loader, title, in game, hi score, ending)
Re-designed and improved game graphics and sprites
16 fun levels
Better jump routine
End screen

You are employed by BLZ Explosives LTD. You are working a night shift in the inbound department of the warehouse, which is partially outside the shipping yard. You have agreed to work this shift and the department, unaware that this department lacks in health and safety requirements. To put it another way, they don't care about these regulations and run rules the way they wish to. That is just typical isn't it?

456503.overview:
Water Bomb is a hangman variant for the Commodore 64. Instead of an executioner, the guy is in a tank, and you must prevent him from drowning by guessing the word.

It was developed by George Trepal, and published in UpTime Vol.1 #04.

457086.overview:
Wall Crawler is a Crazy Climber clone/variant for the Commodore 64,

It was developed by Tony Brantner and published as a type-in game in Ahoy! 1987/05 (Issue #41).

457532.overview: Wheels is a racing game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Scott Elder and published in 1991 as part of Loadstar #083.

457771.overview:
WOW! That's What I Call Shoot 'Em Ups is a compilation of games for the Commodore 64.
Arhena Special Edition, Bank Run, Border Blast 3 Enhanced, Cosmic Combat DX, Double or Nothing, Droid Rumble, Flying Cobra RX, Grayhawk, Operation Metalstorm, Split Second

459053.overview:
In the years following the American Civil War, you lead a simple life as a cowboy. Despite the low wage, you scrimp and save and manage to buy a small ranch near Tucson, Arizona, where you live with your wife Sarah and daughter Betty. You dream of a bright future for your daughter and work hard every day to earn the money needed to provide her with a good education.

Then, one day, your peaceful existence is shattered when Pablo Cortez and his gang raid your ranch on their return to Nogales after a robbery in Tucson. They shoot you in the head and leave you for dead. Luckily for you, the wound is superficial, but, when you come to, you discover that your life savings have been stolen, and Sarah and Betty have been kidnapped. You dress your wound and quickly recover, determined to find Sarah and Betty.

A few hours later, you're in hot pursuit of Cortez's gang. In retrospect, this was a stupid thing to do on your own. Halfway through the desert, your horse dies from the heat and exertion. You're now by yourself, on foot, and your horse lays dead at your feet.

This is a life or death situation. Despite the odds, you must press on if you want to see your family alive again, but consider every move carefully, as the Wild West is a deadly and unforgiving place.

Note: This is the first game in the Kenneth Johnson trilogy. The games are self-contained, but it is recommended that you play them in order. The trilogy consists of:

Kenneth Johnson trilogy #1: Wild West (this game)
Kenneth Johnson trilogy #2: Tin Star
Kenneth Johnson trilogy #3: Desperados

459253.overview:
White Knight is a pinball game for the Commodore 64.

It was developed by JAM using the Pinball Construction SET, and released in 1991 as part of PCS Club Disk #34.

460800.overview:
William Tell is a platform shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by David W. Light where your aim is to rescue the apple of his eye, his son.

The first stage of the game involves the collection of two keys which unlock the doors to the dungeons. Both keys are lo be found hanging up outside the guardroom* located at either end of the battlements. The battlements are patrolled by armed guards who can either be shot with your crossbow or jumped over if your timing's good. Occasionally you must replenish your supply of crossbow bolts by jumping up and collecting them. Timing your jump is vital because arrows and cannonballs are whittling overhead. Once you've got the keys, fight your way back to the ladder m\d then you can descend to the courtyard.

This game was published in the following:

- Your Commodore 1988/11
- Your Commodore 1989/01
- Your Commodore 1989/03

469832.overview: Words Don't Come Easy is a single-player hangman variant for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Trash Productions and published in GO64! 1997/10.

470333.overview: You have to find the correct 3x3 pattern in the Game Area. Your searching skills are being tested to the max.

472422.overview:
Wargle! is a 1-player arcade game for multiple systems.

The player controls a small character within a maze who can move in 4 cardinal directions. The player can fire forwards and backwards. Multiple enemy creatures move about the maze, and work their way towards the player. The player's goal is to shoot all enemies before they touch the player. If the player is hit, they lose a life. The player starts with 5 lives, and when all are lost it's game over.

472778.overview: This Commodore 64 text-driven adventure reimagines H.G. Wells’ The War of the Worlds in a minimalist, atmospheric style. Experience the Martian invasion through carefully crafted scenes, stark 8-bit visuals, and period-inspired typography.

474580.overview:
The War Game is a 1-player war strategy game for the Commodore 64.

It was developed by Alan Bond and released into the public domain in 1986.

474589.overview: You're an intruder sneaking through a palace in disguise. At every door, a guard blocks you and demands to know who you are. The game shows you the disguise you happen to be wearing, and you have to pick the matching identity.

476345.overview: The star of the evening — a plump, proud, perfectly uncooked Turkey — is waiting to be served. There’s only one problem: it absolutely must not touch the filthy kitchen floor. One drop, one splat, one moment of disaster… and you lose a life. Keep it bouncing, keep it clean, and keep your nerves steady as you chase that high score.

478548.overview: The Weather is an educational software title from Grolier / Mindflight that was recently recovered from long-term archival loss in August 2026

479288.overview: Wolf64 is a port of the 1992 FPS classic to the stock Commodore 64 with disk drive.

479489.overview: Imagine a first-person RPG shooter, but top-down...and you get Warlock.

480173.overview:
Something in front of you says three or four words. You have sixteen seconds to say something better. 
Words of Power: Logos is a duel fought with vocabulary. Your opponent speaks; you type a sentence back before the clock runs out; whichever is worth more wins the exchange, and the loser's energy pays for it. Twelve opponents wait, and each one gives you less time than the last.

480361.overview: Potions rain down from the shelves of a wizard's laboratory in vials of six colours. Line up three or more of a colour — horizontally, vertically or diagonally — and they react and vanish, dropping whatever sat above them into new arrangements.

480882.overview:
Would you play a game if your life depended on it?

Marcin found himself in a strange realm - he doesn't remember how he came here, he doesn't remember anything. All he knows is that he needs to play the game in order to restore his identity.

A game by Kamil Wolnikowski, Kamil Trzaska  & Benni Dibb of Retronics, that mixes the arcade and logic game genres. There are 40 levels to beat. In each level the player needs to collect all balls and destroy all humans while avoiding robots that move across the screen. All of that needs to be done in a given time, otherwise the level resets.

480958.overview: Take command of U-96, the most feared submarine in the Kriegsmarine wolfpack. Hunt Allied shipping across the North Atlantic in this homage to the 1976 arcade classic Sea Wolf, recreated in pure 6502 assembly for the Commodore 64.

481019.overview:
A brand-new platformer for the Commodore 64, written 100% in 6502 assembly.
Run, jump, dodge and collect your way through an endless adventure across four hand-crafted worlds. No two games are the same: every level is generated on the fly by the C64 itself, then checked so that every coin, gem and power-up can actually be reached.

481945.overview: 5 circuits, 1 car, 1 team. Will you become the Western European champion? A racing game for the Commodore 64 (Ultimate).

482758.overview: Cowboys, Apache and Sioux raiders ride in from both sides. Shoot them before they reach you, and dodge their bullets!

482791.overview: Join Morphy on a colorful adventure through six sea mazes! Collect dots, grab magic berries and avoid Blip, Blop, Mibo, Squzz and Wobo. Can you complete all six levels?

482793.overview: Type quickly and accurately to destroy the evil WORDVADERS!

482890.overview:
The watch, the old Charlies, walk the closes, each with a lamp, and that light is all they have against you. You are William Burke. Hare keeps the lodging house. Ten pounds a body.

482915.overview: A storm is rattling through the orchard and the apples are coming down. In Windfall you grab your basket and catch them before they hit the grass.
